End loans before moving/dropping an owner; returning buffer transfers it. No loops, recursion, extra functions, external calls or effects outside alloc/read/write/trap; max 16 blocks/128 operations per function. Only scalar, buffer, mutbuf, readbuf types.
Only these two files are editable in BOTH full and node interfaces. The other two remain unchanged.
